messages:
Maya Rivera: Heads-up: deploying service-api v2.8.1 to prod tonight at 22:00 PT. Rolling 5% then 100% if no regressions. Need deploy owner, smoke test owners, rollback readiness, and a short note for CS/Marketing.

Anika Patel: I'll own the deploy and monitor. Plan: 22:00 start, canary at 5% for 10m, health checks at 22:05, then gradual increase to 100% at ~22:15 if all good. I'll post final go/no-go in this thread 15m before deploy.

Tom Baker: I'll run the smoke tests and own the canary validation. Smoke checklist is in the gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/smoke-2-8-1 (short checklist).

Tom Baker: ```
# smoke checks
curl -sSf https://api.redwood.ai/health || exit 1
curl -sSf -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke"}' | jq '.choices'
# check metrics dashboard: svc_api_canary / latency p95 < 400ms / error_rate < 0.2%
```

Jason Li: Rollback plan: if p95 latency > 2s or error rate > 0.5% sustained for >2m during canary, we rollback to v2.8.0. Rollback command is `./scripts/rollback.sh v2.8.0 --force` and I have permissions to execute. I'll be watching the deploy logs.

Priya Shah: Support note: we'll prepare two canned replies (investigating / mitigated) and stand up a triage row in Zendesk. Ping @Priya Shah when canary starts and we'll monitor the queue.

Leo Martins: Marketing: we'll need a 2-line internal blurb + customer-facing note if this is a functional change. Share release notes by 17:00 PT so we can draft the email. Also want a short bullet list of user-facing changes.

Anika Patel: Quick summary for release notes: model routing improvement (no customer action), default param `beta` toggled to false (minor API change, compatible). PR: https://github.com/redwood/service-api/pull/458. I'll drop the changelog here by 16:45.

Maya Rivera: Thanks — @ops-bot can you schedule the deploy job for 22:00 PT and post a 10m warning to #general? Also add the incident hook to the deploy so we can open a channel automatically if we hit rollback.

ops-bot: Scheduled: deploy job created (id: deploy-1767000001) for 2026-03-17T22:00:00-07:00. Reminder posted to #general at 21:50 PT. Incident hook attached to the job.

Tom Baker: I'll be on-call during the window and will post smoke results in this thread. Ping me directly if anything spikes. :thumbsup:

Priya Shah: Got it — support watching and stand-by for customer comms.

Maya Rivera: Final ask: please confirm you've added relevant runbook links (deployment runbook, rollback runbook, smoke checklist) to the deploy job before 21:45 PT. We'll close this thread when all confirmations are in.
